observations: Phase A-H complete: 4 files backed up to .opencode/backups/pre-context-compression-2026-07-30/, branch feat/context-compression cut from main @4604b49, edits applied, verified, merged to main @01771c2 via --no-ff

GLM-5.2 context corrected 128000 -> 200000 (output 8192 unchanged). Evidence: NVIDIA NIM 200K cap, Cloudflare 262K, Warp issue #12980, Cursor forum consensus. 1M requires [1m] opt-in via Z.ai directly (not exposed by hcnsec reseller).

Compaction block on main opencode.json (line 554-560) and Projects/neodev-portal/opencode.json (line 383-389) switched from {auto:false, tail_turns:15} to V1 sane-max: {auto:true, prune:true, tail_turns:3, preserve_recent_tokens:8000, reserved:40000}

Each V1 field evidence-backed: auto:true because issue #30664 shows auto:false bypassed by provider-overflow auto-compaction; prune:true because issue #24108 docs/source disagree on default; tail_turns:3 because issue #30811 quality degrades after N compactions (1 above default 2); preserve_recent_tokens:8000 matches source MAX_PRESERVE_RECENT_TOKENS; reserved:40000 mitigates issue #10634 large-tool-output overflow

opencode v1.18.9 binary only supports V1 (lossy) compaction. V2 fields (keep.tokens, buffer) silently ignored. Binary scan: tail_turns 3 matches, preserve_recent_tokens 3 matches, keep.tokens 0 matches.
